purpose: Eight more 2026/27 full home kit component references with independently recorded evidence and SWOS colour approximations; research only, no TEAM modification

entries.sourceClassification: Two independently published 2026/27 Joma full-kit reports
entries.note: The 2026/27 Norwich strip has green shorts with yellow detailing and yellow socks with green Joma markings. SWOS solid colours omit the marbled shirt and sock effect.

entries.sourceClassification: Official 2026/27 Charlton club shop whites shorts + explicit red sock description
entries.note: The current Charlton Athletic 2026/27 home shorts are white, and the Reebok home sock is predominantly red with a white logo, per the official club shop. Existing white shorts code preserved.

entries.sourceClassification: Dated 2026/27 Macron strip release and kit archive
entries.note: The 2026/27 Stoke City red-and-white striped shirt is paired with white shorts with red side stripes and red socks with a white turnover. SWOS cannot reproduce fine trim.

entries.sourceClassification: 2026/27 Adidas full-kit review corroborated by Leicester official home store
entries.note: Leicester City 2026/27 home kit uses blue shorts with white side panels and blue socks with white LCFC and adidas detailing. SWOS blue is a single-colour simplification.

entries.sourceClassification: Official 2026/27 Rovers club store explicitly specifies both colours
entries.note: Blackburn Rovers 26/27 authentic home shorts are blue with white side panels; the official home socks have a blue base and red Umbro logo. SWOS records the dominant blue.

entries.sourceClassification: QPR 26/27 official store and independent complete Erreà kit reviews
entries.note: Queens Park Rangers' 2026/27 home strip has white shorts and white socks with blue and amber detailing. The white shorts already recorded are preserved. 2025/26 socks are not used as a substitute.

entries.sourceClassification: Dated 2026/27 full-kit release plus club store socks/shorts products
entries.note: For the standard Middlesbrough 150th season red home strip, red shorts and red socks with gold detailing are documented. SWOS cannot represent gold trim.

entries.sourceClassification: Independent 2026/27 full-kit coverage with corroborating kit release
entries.note: Hull City's 26/27 home kit pairs white shorts with evenly amber-and-black hooped socks. SWOS cannot render hooped socks; Orange is a deliberate amber approximation rather than a claim that the socks are plain orange.
